sloka: प्राचीम् होत्रे ददौ राजा दिशम् स्वकुल वर्धनःअध्वर्यवे प्रतीचीम् तु ब्रह्मणे दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ॥१-१४-४३॥
transliteration: prācīm hotre dadau rājā diśam svakula vardhanaḥadhvaryave pratīcīm tu brahmaṇe dakṣiṇām diśam ॥1-14-43॥

translations.english: The king best among men and upholder of his dynasty, having concluded the sacrifice according to law, offered this entire earth as gift to priests.
